title: Hanford's cumulative liquid-effluent transfer series progresses past 2.26 million gallons
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hanford Field Office
summary: The monthly reports raise the cumulative Effluent Management Facility transfer threshold from more than 1.55 million gallons to more than 1.846 million and then more than 2.26 million gallons transferred to the Liquid Effluent Retention Facility. Denominator: Three cumulative liquid-effluent transfer thresholds for the same origin and destination facilities under the same monthly reporting series.
key_findings: Finding: The monthly reports raise the cumulative Effluent Management Facility transfer threshold from more than 1.55 million gallons to more than 1.846 million and then more than 2.26 million gallons transferred to the Liquid Effluent Retention Facility.
Denominator: Three cumulative liquid-effluent transfer thresholds for the same origin and destination facilities under the same monthly reporting series.
Boundary: Threshold observations do not support exact monthly transfer volumes.
